question: Azidothymidine (AZT) used against the human immunodeficiency virus:

options.opa: It binds to the cellular RNA polymerase and blocks transcription.
options.opb: It binds to the early promoter of the virus and prevents its recognition by RNA polymerase.
options.opc: Antagonizes the phosphorylation of nucleosides, thus inhibiting the synthesis of viral DNA.
options.opd: Blocks the transport of thymidine to the cellular interior.
